responsibility: Verifies one frozen task contract deterministically against the evidence actually submitted and records exactly one verification result for it.
mutation_interface: none — it appends only through cis.assurance.authority's verifier facade, which owns verification_inputs and verification_results
execution_location: in-process, cis-clean application process; it executes nothing, re-runs nothing and has no worker
failure_boundary: fail_closed — a task contract or task_execution_inputs authority row whose independent digest, state, hash domain or stored-byte digest does not recompute is REFUSED and no result is recorded at all, because a recorded VERIFIED_FAIL would legitimise tampered authority as something that was assessed; missing, malformed, incomplete or mismatched returned evidence is instead an assessment outcome and is recorded as VERIFIED_FAIL with a reason code; a required check this verifier cannot perform is VERIFIED_FAIL and never a silent pass
recovery_behavior: Idempotent — a task contract whose verification is already recorded returns that row instead of appending a second, since the submitted evidence is immutable and a second verification could only restate the first
replacement_contract: A replacement must be a pure function of recorded authority with no clock, socket or environment input; must assemble its own inputs through its own port and persist them in verification_inputs rather than by altering backend_runs; must independently recompute task-contract and execution-input authority; must require the evidence content digest to bind the exact attestation text and durable run result; must parse only the closed contained-worker adapter attestation and bind its candidate, vectors, entrypoint, image, runner, worker and result classification to that authority; must treat absent or mismatched returned evidence as a recorded failure rather than silence; must refuse rather than assess tampered authority; and must remain unable to reach the reviewer or promotion module through any chain of dependencies
evidence_produced: one verification_inputs row carrying the assembled submission, the digests the verifier recomputed, and assembled_by naming this module
one verification_results row whose outcome, reason code, checks performed and findings reproduce exactly from the same ledger
a VERIFIED_FAIL carrying MISSING_SUBMITTED_EVIDENCE when nothing was submitted
a TaskContractTampered or ExecutionInputTampered, and no recorded result, when authoritative input does not recompute
a VERIFIED_PASS only when the closed adapter attestation matches the exact authorized candidate, vectors, entrypoint, worker image, trusted runner, worker and closed result tuple
